title: A markdown code block draws as rendered markdown, with a toggle to its source
body:
coax draws a fenced code block through `cmr::layout`, which highlights the lines by the fence's language. A block fenced as `markdown` comes out as plain white source, since markdown is the language cmr renders rather than one it highlights. Agents fence markdown when the person should see its source, as in a proposed issue body or a commit message.

## Proposal

- coax draws a `markdown` fence by passing its lines through `cmr::parse` and laying the blocks out inside the code block's box, at the box's inner width.
- The box's header row gets a `raw|render` chip beside the copy button. A click switches that block between rendered and source. Rendered is the default.
- The copy button takes the source in either view.
- coax keeps the choice per block, as it keeps `pans` for panned blocks.

## Open

- A rendered block may hold its own code blocks and tables. These need their own copy buttons and panning, nested in the outer box.
